title: General-purpose language models are neurosymbolic reasoners able to annotate proteins from sequence
abstract: arXiv:2611.28529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Determining the function of genes across the tree of life is one of the major challenges in biology. Generative AI approaches to this problem generally fall into two categories: language models trained on biological sequences that are able to predict structure and function from signals in those sequences; and generalist language models trained on text, that are able to reason about biological function symbolically. A default operating assumption is that protein language models do not perform well on symbolic tasks, and that generalist language models do not perform well on sequence tasks. However, a recent report showed that frontier generalist models perform surprisingly well on next-residue prediction tasks. We set out to explore whether these capabilities extended to protein annotation.   We assigned different frontier generalist models a variety of protein annotation tasks, including predicting the presence and coordinates of Pfam

translated_title: 通用语言模型是能够从序列注释蛋白质的神经符号推理器
translated_abstract: 确定生命之树中基因的功能是生物学领域的主要挑战之一。针对这一问题的生成式AI方法通常分为两类：一类是在生物序列上训练的语言模型，能够从序列信号中预测结构和功能；另一类是在文本上训练的通用语言模型，能够对生物功能进行符号推理。人们通常默认认为，蛋白质语言模型在符号任务上表现不佳，而通用语言模型在序列任务上表现不佳。然而，最近一份报告显示，前沿通用模型在下一残基预测任务上表现出惊人的能力。我们着手探索这些能力是否可以扩展到蛋白质注释任务中。我们给不同的前沿通用模型分配了多种蛋白质注释任务，包括预测Pfam结构域的存在及其坐标……
tldr: 该论文发现前沿通用语言模型能够作为神经符号推理器，直接从氨基酸序列完成蛋白质功能注释任务，打破了通用模型不擅长序列任务的固有假设。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that frontier general-purpose language models can act as neurosymbolic reasoners capable of annotating proteins directly from amino acid sequences, challenging the assumption that generalist models perform poorly on sequence-based tasks.
